prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1365; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to my side of things. You can refer to me as the driver of the vehicle.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was making a left turn at a signalized intersection in Katy, Texas. I had the green arrow, or at least I thought I did.

Q: What was the traffic like at the time?

A: Pretty steady. There was a car in the oncoming lane waiting to go straight, and a delivery truck was parked near the corner.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: Not until the last second. It came through from the opposite direction and clipped the front passenger side of my car.

Q: How fast were you traveling?

A: Maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour. I was already slowing down for the turn.

Q: Did your airbags deploy?

A: No. The impact jolted me forward and then back into the seat, and that's when my lower back started to hurt.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They diagnosed a lumbar strain and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatories. I've also started physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any other symptoms?

A: Some stiffness when I get up in the morning, and it's hard to sit for long periods. I've missed a few days of work because of it.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was careful and I believe the other driver should have yielded. I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
